settings.narrative: In an era of mass-produced plastic objects, Wolko honors the quiet luxury of natural fibers, manual stitch-work, and personal intention. Every piece carries the warmth of the hands that held it first.

settings.description: In our Indian artisan ateliers, we deliberately reject industrial assembly lines. Every Wolko creation begins as raw ethical merino wool roving, patiently sculpted row by row using fingers and traditional wooden hooks.

Woven from a continuous spool of virgin Australian merino wool blend. The Cloud Tote molds effortlessly to your side, offering a pillowy weight that turns the simplest morning walk or cafe visit into a tactile luxury.
